statement.label: [01 / POSITIONING & MANIFESTO]
statement.paragraph: Bridging the depth of low-level systems computing (compilers, bytecode runtimes, and VMs) with the fluid responsiveness of modern web interfaces and production generative AI pipelines.

bento.label: [01.5 / ARCHITECTURE & CORE PILLARS]
bento.headline: Deep systems computing, high availability, and applied AI in production.
bento.paragraph: Three unified engineering disciplines: from compiler design and virtual machine runtimes to resilient enterprise platforms and autonomous agent workflows.
bento.axisLowLevelDesc: Lexical parsing, AST generation, bytecode emission, and virtual machines. Complete mastery of computing fundamentals.
bento.axisAppDesc: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Clean Architecture. Robust enterprise platforms built for scale.
bento.axisAiDesc: Model Context Protocol (MCP), dynamic LLM tool calling, agent orchestration, and local inference via Ollama.
bento.dualSubtitle: How I collaborate depending on your team's strategic goals.
bento.techPillar1Desc: Architecture decisions backed by documented ADRs, strict layer decoupling (Clean Arch), dependency injection, and deterministic production predictability.
bento.techPillar2Desc: Strict TypeScript with zero 'any', schema-validated API contracts (Zod), and deterministic test coverage across critical user paths.
bento.techPillar3Desc: Deep understanding of hardware layers, memory models, event loops, and compilation pipelines to eradicate bottlenecks hidden beneath frameworks.
bento.bizPillar1Desc: Fast delivery of functional products, enterprise portals, and high-converting web experiences that elevate brand positioning above competitors.
bento.bizPillar2Desc: Integration of autonomous agents and LLM tool chains that deliver measurable operational leverage, cutting manual overhead and operational costs.
bento.bizPillar3Desc: Systems engineered to last: no costly rewrites 6 months post-launch because core foundations are built scalably from day one.

releases.label: [02 / PRODUCTION CASES & SYSTEMS]
releases.headline: Proprietary systems and releases engineered for scale.
releases.paragraph: The interactive deck on the right functions as a tangible stack of engineering cards. Each project tackles critical challenges: from compiler design to agentic orchestration with MCP protocol and high-concurrency enterprise portals.
